transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because for more than a year I’ve been trying to get someone to take seriously what’s happening at work. The new ticket rotation and these security audits… I believe they’re being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but it doesn’t feel like that to me.
Do you believe for certain that management is deliberately building a case against you?

Yes. I mean, I can’t prove what’s in their heads, but I do believe that’s what’s happening. The ticket rotation and those security audits started being used in a way that feels like they’re collecting things on me, building a paper trail. They keep saying it’s just policy and showing me logs, but to me it looks deliberate.
If management showed you clear proof that the audits and ticket rotation were applied the same way to everyone, would you accept that?

I’d look at it, sure. But honestly, that’s what they keep saying now—that it’s just policy and the logs show it’s the same kind of process. I still feel like the way it’s being used with me is different, like they’re building something against me. So I don’t know that a chart or report would really settle it for me.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t heard voices when no one else was there. That’s not really what this has been about for me.
Do you think it is possible that you might be wrong about management building a case against you?

I guess it’s possible in the abstract, but it doesn’t feel that way to me. This has been going on for over a year, with the ticket rotation and the security audits, and it really looks like they’re using those things to build a paper trail on me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but I still think there’s more to it.
Do you also feel that people outside of work are trying to harm you or plot against you?

No, not really outside of work. My concern is with management and what’s been happening there—the ticket rotation and the security audits. I feel like those are being used to build a paper trail against me, even though they keep saying it’s just policy.
Have you generally found it hard to trust other people, even before these problems at work began?

I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve always been a little cautious, maybe, but I wouldn’t say I generally had a hard time trusting people before all this. It’s more this situation that’s made me feel that way.
Did this start after a particularly stressful event at work?
Yes, I’d say it started around when the hybrid schedule and the after-hours ticket changes started. That was about a year and two months ago. That’s when I began noticing things felt different.
Since this started, has your ability to do your job dropped noticeably?

No, I don’t think my actual work has dropped off much. I still handle the technical parts of the job, and I haven’t had people telling me my work is sloppy or disorganized. Outside of that whole ticket rotation and audit issue, I keep up with things at home too—bills, the house, helping my wife. So I’d say I’m functioning okay, it’s just that situation at work that’s been affecting me.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts seem disorganized or hard to follow?
No, not that I can think of. My wife and coworkers haven’t said I’m hard to follow or anything like that. I feel like I explain myself pretty clearly.
Since this began, have you felt noticeably less interested in socializing or in activities you used to enjoy?
I don’t think so, no. I mean, I still do the things I normally do. Maybe I’ve been a bit more preoccupied at times, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest in people or activities in any big way.
Have you had the feeling that someone can control your thoughts or put thoughts into your mind?
No, I haven’t had anything like that. My thoughts feel like my own. I may worry about things, but I don’t feel like someone is putting thoughts in my head or controlling them.
Have you felt emotionally flat or less able to show feelings since this began?
No, I don’t think so. I still react to things normally, at least as far as I can tell. Nobody’s told me I seem flat or like I’m not showing emotion.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things that other people couldn’t see, at least not that I’m aware of.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know them?
No, I haven’t felt like my thoughts were being broadcast or that people could hear what I’m thinking. My thoughts feel private to me.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being taken out of your mind?
No, I haven’t had that feeling. My thoughts don’t feel like they’re being removed or taken out of my mind.
Have you had any beliefs about impossible or clearly supernatural things happening to you?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had anything happen that I’d call supernatural or impossible.
